body.name: Residual variance envelope
body.construction: For even \(n\ge N_0\) and \(z\in\{0,1\}\), let \(\beta_{z,n}=S_{xx,n}^{-1}S_{x,Y(z),n}\) and \(e_{z,ni}=Y_{ni}(z)-\bar Y_n(z)-\beta_{z,n}^{\mathsf T}x_{ni}\). Set \(u_n=2S_{e_1e_1,n}+2S_{e_0e_0,n}\), so algebraically \(u_n-s_n^2=S_{e_1-e_0,e_1-e_0,n}\ge0\).
